posts.title: Sadness, Madness & Gladness
posts.description: Only two kinds of people can hear my songs: Those who see the world with pure, childlike wonder, and those with a deep sense of loss in their hearts. To everyone else, I'm just a period in a sentence in the book of Ooo. This is a quote from Aventure Time. It might be familiar to many, but it isn't to me. posts.title: Publishing EPUBs with Pandoc
posts.description: I mainly use Typst for all my PDF generation. I like it, it's simple, powerful, and it's easy to make things that look great. I use it for things that are not PDF generation, like making the layouts and frames for Bloodless cards. This does come with a small problem. Typst doesn't support EPUB export yet. posts.title: Outlining is just 7D pantsing.
posts.description: I've always been kind of a pantser myself, which is why I was a little surprised when, for Heaven Reaches Out to Us , I decided to make an outline first instead. And, look, maybe this is my obsession with blurring every line and removing every division, but after having been on both sides, I don't really think they are necessarily opposite categories.
